items.name: Bleed
items.description: Inflicts 2 stacks of bleed. Bleeding enemies receive 1 damage per stack when hit by a ball (max 8 stacks).

items.name: Brood Mother
items.description: Has a 25% chance of birthing a baby ball each time it hits an enemy.

items.name: Burn
items.description: Add 1 stack of burn on hit for 3 seconds (max 3 stacks). Burnt units are dealt 4-8 damage per stack per second.

items.name: Cell
items.description: Splits into a clone on hit 2 times.

items.name: Charm
items.description: Each hit has a 4% chance of charming the enemy for 5 seconds. Charmed units walk up the board and attack enemies.

items.name: Dark
items.description: Deals 3.0x damage but destroys itself after hitting an enemy. Has a 3 second cooldown before it can be shot again.

items.name: Earthquake
items.description: Deals 5-13 damage to nearby units in a 3x3 tile square.

items.name: Egg Sac
items.description: Explodes into 2-4 baby balls on hitting an enemy. Has a 3 second cooldown before it can be shot again.

items.name: Flesh
items.description: Speed increases by 25% per bounce.

items.name: Freeze
items.description: Has a 4% chance to freeze enemies for 5.0 seconds. Frozen enemies receive 25% more damage.

items.name: Ghost
items.description: Passes through enemies.

items.name: Iron
items.description: Deals double damage but moves 40% slower.

items.name: Laser (Horizontal)
items.description: Deals 9-18 damage to all enemies in the same row.

items.name: Laser (Vertical)
items.description: Deals 9-18 damage to all enemies in the same column.

items.name: Light
items.description: Blinds enemies on hit for 3 seconds. Blinded units have a hard time detecting you and have a 50% chance of missing when they attack.

items.name: Lightning
items.description: Deals 1-20 damage to up to 3 nearby enemies.

items.name: Poison
items.description: Applies 1 stack of poison on hit (max 5 stacks). Poison lasts for 6 seconds and each stack deals 1-4 damage per second.

items.name: Stone
items.description: Initially deals 300% damage. Damage erodes by 40% each time hitting an enemy (minimum 50%).

items.name: Time
items.description: Explodes into a time snare upon hitting an enemy, which stays on the field for 20 seconds and freezes enemies inside it.

items.name: Vampire
items.description: Each hit has a 4.5% chance of healing 1 health.

items.name: Wind
items.description: Passes through enemies and slows them down by 30% for 5 seconds, but deals 25% less damage.

items.name: Assassin
items.description: Passes through the front of enemies, but not the back. Backstabs deal 30% bonus damage.

items.name: Banished Flame
items.description: Add 1 stack of darkflame on hit for 2 seconds (max 6 stacks). Darkflame deals 1-30 damage per stack per second. When the darkflame goes out, it deals 1-100 to the enemy.

items.name: Berserk
items.description: Each hit has a 30% chance of causing enemies to go berserk for 6 seconds. Berserk enemies deal 15-24 damage to adjacent enemies every second

items.name: Blizzard
items.description: Freezes all enemies within a 2 tile radius for 0.8 seconds, dealing 1-50 damage

items.name: Bomb
items.description: Explodes when hitting an enemy, dealing 150-300 damage to nearby enemies. Has a 3 second cooldown before it can be shot again
items.evolvesFurther: Yes, to Nuclear Bomb with Poison. Or into Time Bomb with Time

items.name: Brimstone
items.description: Applies 1 stack of burn and poison every second to all enemies within a 2 tile radius (max 4 stacks). Burn deals 1-4 damage per stack per second and poison deals 2-3 damage per stack per second.

items.name: Catapult
items.description: Launches 3-5 stone baby balls every 1.5 seconds, which are destroyed after hitting anything.

items.name: Drill
items.description: Pierces enemies and deals 50% bonus damage until reaching the back of the field.

items.name: Elemental
items.description: Applies a random status effect (burn, slow, or freeze) to nearby enemies on hit.

items.name: Erosion
items.description: Passes through enemies. Deals 3% of enemy's current health as bonus damage on hit.

items.name: Fireworks
items.description: Explodes into 3-6 fireworks. Fireworks target random enemies, dealing 20-30 damage and applying 1 stack of burn. Burnt units are dealt 7-11 damage per stack per second.

items.name: Flash
items.description: Damage all enemies on screen for 1-3 damage after hitting an enemy and blind them for 2 seconds

items.name: Flesh Mound
items.description: Emites a fleshy baby ball in a random direction every 1.0 seconds.

items.name: Flicker
items.description: Deals 1-7 damage to every enemy on screen every 1.4 seconds

items.name: Freeze Ray
items.description: Emits a freeze ray when hitting an enemy, dealing 20-50 to all enemies in its path, with a 10% chance of freezing them for 10.0 seconds

items.name: Frozen Flame
items.description: Add 1 stack of frostburn on hit for 20 seconds (max 4 stacks). Frostburnt units are dealt 8-12 damage per stack per second and receive 25% more damage from other sources

items.name: Glacier
items.description: Releases glacial spikes over time that deal 15-30 to enemies that touch them and freeze them for 2.0 seconds. This ball and its glacial spikes also deal 6-12 damage to nearby units

items.name: Heart Swallower
items.description: Saps enemies on hit, with a 40% chance of stealing 1 health and reducing their attack damage by 20%. Lifesteal chance only applies once per enemy.
items.evolvesFurther: Yes, into Reaper with Soul Sucker

items.name: Hemorrhage
items.description: Inflicts 3 stacks of bleed. When hitting an enemy with 12 stacks of bleed or more, consumes all stacks of bleed to deal 20% of their current health

items.name: Holy Laser
items.description: Deals 24-36 damage to all enemies in the same row and column
items.evolvesFurther: Yes, into X Ray with Laser Beam

items.name: Incubus
items.description: Each hit has a 4% chance of charming the enemy for 9 seconds. Charmed enemies curse nearby enemies. Cursed enemies are dealt 100-200 after being hit 5 times

items.name: Inferno
items.description: Applies 1 stack of burn every second to all enemies within a 2 tile radius. Burn lasts for 6 seconds, dealing 3-7 damage per stack per seconds

items.name: Landslide
items.description: Creates a landslide and destroys self upon hitting an enemy. The landslide lasts for 5 seconds and deals 20-30 damage per second to enemies within a 2 tile radius

items.name: Laser Beam
items.description: Emit a laser beam on hit that deals 30-42 damage and blinds enemies for 8 seconds
items.evolvesFurther: Yes, into X Ray with Holy Laser

items.name: Leech
items.description: Attaches up to 1 leech onto enemies it hits, which add 2 stacks of bleed per seconds (max 24 stacks)

items.name: Lightning Bug
items.description: Spawns a lightning bug each time it hits an enemy. Lightning bugs attack a random enemy, dealing 1-80 damage to up to 3 nearby enemies.

items.name: Lightning Rod
items.description: Plants a lightning rod into enemies it hits. These enemies are struck by lightning every 3.0 seconds, dealing 1-30 damage to up to 8 nearby enemies

items.name: Lovestruck
items.description: Inflicts lovestruck on hit enemies for 20 seconds. Lovestruck units have a 50% chance of healing you for 5 health when they attack

items.name: Maggot
items.description: Infest enemies on hit with maggots. When they dies, they explode into 1-2 baby balls

items.name: Magma
items.description: Emits lava blobs over time. Enemies who walk into lava blobs are dealt 15-30 damage and gain 1 stack of burn (max 3 stacks). Burn lasts for 3 seconds, dealing 3-8 damage per stack per second. This ball and its lava blobs also deal 6-12 damage to nearby units

items.name: Mosquito King
items.description: Spawns a mosquito each time it hits an enemy. Mosquitos attack a random enemy, dealing 80-120 damage each. If a mosquito kills an enemy, they steal 1 health
items.evolvesFurther: Yes, to Nosferatu together with both Vampire Lord and Spider Queen, and to Mosquito Kingdom together with Mosquito Swarm

items.name: Mosquito Swarm
items.description: Explodes into 3-6 mosquitos. Mosquitos attack random enemies, dealing 80-120 damage each. If a mosquito kills an enemy, they steal 1 health
items.evolvesFurther: Yes, to Mosquito Kingdom together with Mosquito King

items.name: Noxious
items.description: Passes through enemies and applies 3 stacks of poison to nearby enemies within a 2 tile radius. Poison lasts for 4 seconds and each stack deals 1-3 damage per second

items.name: Offspring
items.description: Splits into a clone on hit 4 times.

items.name: Overgrowth
items.description: Applies 1 stack of overgrowth. Upon reaching 3, consume all stacks and deal 150-200 damage to all enemies in a 3x3 tile square

items.name: Petrify
items.description: Petrifies all enemies within its sightline for 1.5 seconds when first launched, dealing 50-120.

items.name: Phantom
items.description: Curse enemies on hit. Cursed enemies are dealt 100-200 damage after being hit 5 times
items.evolvesFurther: Yes, to Banshee together with Wraith

items.name: Radiation Beam
items.description: Emit a radiation beam on hit that deals 24-48 damage and applies 1 stack of radiation (max 5 stacks). Radiation lasts for 15 seconds and cause enemies to receive 10% more damage from all sources per stack

items.name: Sacrifice
items.description: Inflicts 4 stacks of bleed (max 15 stacks) and applies curse to hit enemies. Cursed enemies are dealt 50-100 after being hit 5 times

items.name: Sandstorm
items.description: Goes through enemies and is surrounded by a raging storm dealing 10-20 damage per second and blinding nearby enemies for 3 seconds

items.name: Shotgun
items.description: Shoots 3-7 iron baby balls after hitting a wall. Iron baby balls move at 200% speed but are destroyed upon hitting anything

items.name: Soul Sucker
items.description: Passes through enemies and saps them, with a 30% chance of stealing 1 health and reducing their attack damage by 20%. Lifesteal chance only applies once per enemy
items.evolvesFurther: Yes, into Reaper with Heart Swallower

items.name: Spider Queen
items.description: Has a 25% chance of birthing an Egg Sac each time it hits an enemy
items.evolvesFurther: Yes, to Nosferatu together with both Vampire Lord and Mosquito King

items.name: Steel
items.description: Initially deals double damage but moves 50% slower. Damage increases by 10% each time it hits an enemy (max 300%).
items.evolvesFurther: Yes, into Laser Cutter with Laser (Horizontal) or Laser (Vertical)

items.name: Storm
items.description: Emits lightning to strike nearby enemies every second, dealing 1-40 damage

items.name: Succubus
items.description: Each hit has a 4% chance of charming the enemy for 9 seconds. Heals 1 when hitting a charmed enemy

items.name: Sun
items.description: Blind all enemies in view and add 1 stack of burn every second (max 5 stacks). Burn lasts for 6 seconds and deals 6-12 damage per stack per second
items.evolvesFurther: Yes, into Black Hole with Dark or Time

items.name: Swamp
items.description: Leaves behind tar blobs over time. Enemies who walk into tar blobs are dealt 15-30, are slowed by 50% for 7 seconds and gain 1 stack of poison (max 8 stacks). Each stack of poison deals 1-3 damage per second. This ball and its tar blobs also deal 6-12 damage to nearby units

items.name: Timestop
items.description: Freezes everything on the field for 5.0 seconds but destroys itself after hitting an enemy. Has a 30 second cooldown before it can be shot again.

items.name: Vampire Lord
items.description: Each hit inflicts 3 stacks of bleed. Heals 1 health and consumes all stacks when hitting an enemy with at least 10 stacks of bleed
items.evolvesFurther: Yes, to Nosferatu with both Spider Queen and Mosquito King

items.name: Venom
items.description: Applies 1 stack of venom on hit (max 8 stacks). Each stack deal 3-6 damage per second and slows down enemies.

items.name: Virus
items.description: Applies 1 stack of disease to units it hits (max 8 stacks). Disease lasts for 6 seconds. Each stack of disease deals 3-6 damage per second and diseased units have a 15% chance of passing a stack to undiseased nearby enemies each second

items.name: Voluptuous Egg Sac
items.description: Explodes into 2-3 egg sacs on hitting an enemy. Has a 3 second cooldown before it can be shot again

items.name: Warp
items.description: After each hit, warps to a random spot on the field and speeds up by 5%.

items.name: Wraith
items.description: Freezes any enemy it passes through for 0.8 seconds

items.name: Zombie
items.description: Infects enemies on hit, giving them a 40% chance to turn into a friendly zombie on death

items.name: Armageddon
items.description: Creates a meteor shower upon hitting an enemy. The meteor shower lasts for 5 seconds and deals 30-50 damage / second to enemies within a 3 tile radius.

items.name: Banshee
items.description: Curses all enemies while on the field when launched. Cursed enemies are dealt 150-300 after being hit 6 times.

items.name: Black Hole
items.description: Instantly kills the first non-boss enemy that it hits, but destroys itself afterwards. Has a 7 second cooldown before it can be shot again

items.name: Laser Cutter
items.description: Constantly emits a laser in front of it, which deals 100-150 damage per second.

items.name: Mosquito Kingdom
items.description: Spawns 1-2 mosquitos each time it hits an enemy. Mosquitos attack a random enemy, dealing 100-150 damage each. If a mosquito kills an enemy, they steal 2 health.

items.name: Nosferatu
items.description: Spawns a vampire bat each bounce. Vampire bats fly towards a random enemy, dealing 132-176 damage on hit, turning into a Vampire Lord
items.recipeText: Vampire Lord + Spider Queen + Mosquito King

items.name: Nuclear Bomb
items.description: Explodes when hitting an enemy, dealing 300-500 damage to nearby enemies and applying 1 stack of radiation to everyone present indefinitely (max 5 stacks). Each stack of radiation increases damage received by 10%. Has a 3 second cooldown

items.name: Reaper
items.description: Has a 10% chance to kill enemies on impact, healing you for 5 health.

items.name: Satan
items.description: While active, add 1 stack of burn to all active enemies per second (max 5 stacks), dealing 10-20 damage per stack per second and make them go berserk, dealing 15-24 damage to adjacent enemies every second

items.name: Sniper
items.description: Pierces enemies and shoots 3-7 sniper baby balls after hitting a wall. Sniper baby balls pierce enemies but are destroyed upon hitting a wall.

items.name: Time Bomb
items.description: Throws a time bomb every few seconds, which explodes after a delay, dealing 80-120 damage to nearby enemies.

items.name: Tumor
items.description: Applies tumor on hit, Enemies with a tumor die after 40 seconds (exept for bosses).

items.name: X Ray
items.description: Emits an X-shaped laser on hit, which deals 50-75 damage to enemies and applies 1 stack of radiation (max 5 stacks). Radiation causes enemies to receive 10% more damage from all sources per stack.
